an8.76:1.3: uṭṭhānasampadā, ārakkhasampadā, kalyāṇamittatā, samajīvikatā, saddhāsampadā, sīlasampadā, cāgasampadā, paññāsampadāti.
an8.76:1.5: idha bhikkhave kulaputto yena kammaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti
an8.76:1.6: yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena,
an8.76:1.7: tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrūpāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ,
an8.76:2.2: idha bhikkhave kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā so te ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti
an8.76:2.3: ‘kinti me bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi ḍaheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyunti.
an8.76:3.2: idha bhikkhave, kulaputto yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati. tattha ye te honti gahapati vā gahapati puttā vā daharā vā vuddhasīlino vuddhā vā vuddhasīlino saddhāsampannā sīlasampannā cāgasampannā paññāsampannā, tehi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati, sallapati, sākacchaṃ samāpajjati. yathārūpānaṃ saddhāsampannānaṃ saddhāsampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ sīlasampannānaṃ sīlasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ cāgasampannānaṃ cāgasampadaṃ anusikkhati, yathārūpānaṃ paññāsampannānaṃ paññāsampadaṃ anusikkhati.
an8.76:4.2: idha bhikkhave, kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappetī na accogāḷhaṃ, nātihīnaṃ, evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
an8.76:4.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, tulādhāro vā tulādhārantevāsī vā tulaṃ paggahetvā jānāti ettakenava onataṃ ettakena vā unnatanti.
an8.76:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, na ca accogāḷhaṃ, na atihīnaṃ. evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
an8.76:4.5: sacāyaṃ bhikkhave, kulaputto appāyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro udumbarakhādikaṃ vāyaṃ kulaputto bhoge khādatīti.
an8.76:4.6: sace panāyaṃ bhikkhave, kulaputto mahāyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro: ajaddhumārikaṃ vāyaṃ kulaputto marissatī’ti.
an8.76:4.7: yato ca khvāyaṃ bhikkhave kulaputto āyaṃ ca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samaṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti na accogāḷhaṃ na atihīnaṃ, evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
an8.76:5.2: idha bhikkhave, kulaputto saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
an8.76:5.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
an8.76:6.2: idha bhikkhave kulaputto pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmeraya majjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
an8.76:7.2: idha bhikkhave, kulaputto vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati …pe… yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato,
an8.76:8.2: idha bhikkhave kulaputto paññavā hoti …pe… sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
